preconditions.description: The number of brains n is between 2 and 200000, inclusive.
The list p contains exactly n - 1 elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p[i] <= i for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: Each element in p is a valid brain number that is less than or equal to its index, meaning the connections are valid.

postconditions.description: The output list contains exactly n - 1 elements.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == i + 1 for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: The brain latency after the brain number k is added is exactly k - 1.
